user.title: Set up Yahoo Fantasy Football
user.description: Enter your league id or full Yahoo league URL. If anonymous access is refused, optionally supply the Cookie request header from this league endpoint while signed in to Yahoo. It is a login secret: enter it here, not in chat or an issue. Only supported Yahoo session cookies are kept. Leave the display name blank to use the league name.

data_description.yahoo_session_cookie: Copy the Cookie request header from the signed-in Yahoo league data request. Do not paste your Yahoo password. Stored in HA configuration; renew it when Yahoo expires the session.

team.title: Which team is yours?
team.description: Pick your team in {league} to get a sensor for your own matchup. Choose none for the league scoreboard only.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Yahoo session
reauth_confirm.description: Yahoo rejected this session or the account cannot access the league. Paste a fresh Cookie request header from the same league endpoint while signed in to an account with league access. The existing league and team selections will be preserved.

error.invalid_league_id: No league id found. Enter the number from your league URL, or paste the whole address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Yahoo, or that league id returned nothing. Check the id and try again.
error.yahoo_access_denied: Yahoo refused anonymous access (HTTP 401/403). Supply a valid Yahoo session cookie in the optional field, or check the project troubleshooting notes.
error.invalid_session_cookie: Enter a valid Cookie request header containing Yahoo session cookies, without line breaks. Do not enter a password or a full set of HTTP request headers.
error.session_rejected: Yahoo rejected the supplied session or this account cannot access the league. Sign in to Yahoo, verify that this league opens, then copy a fresh Cookie request header.
